prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1160; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with the trunk lid bent slightly at the lower edge. The pattern of damage lines up well with the rear-end impact described, and I see no sign of older repairs or prior damage in the affected panels. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, the taillight assembly and the trunk lid skin, then refinish the rear section. Two similar charges posted on the same day are still being reviewed against the work order. The labor hours on the estimate run a little high for this scope, so I have asked the shop to justify them before approval.
